title: HooksCommand
responsibility: Registers the hooks commands: install, uninstall, status and run.

inputs.name: registerHooksCommand.program
inputs.description: The parent Commander Command instance passed to registerHooksCommand. It is required to attach the hooks subcommand and its install, uninstall, status, and run commands.

outputs.name: registerHooksCommand
outputs.description: The Commander Command instance created for the hooks subcommand and returned by registerHooksCommand. It contains install, uninstall, status, and run commands.
